title: Argentinian Masarepa Toast
description: A simple dish from Argentina, combining masarepa with toast for a hearty meal.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of fix salsa to the pan and spread evenly.
Place the slices of toast in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1/4 cup of quick cheese on each slice of toast.
Add 1/2 cup of cooked masarepa on top of the cheese.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
